_note: Counts prefixed n_runs_ are Saltelli rows (one qoi.csv line each; in sampled mode several rows share one solve); counts prefixed n_blocks_ are Saltelli blocks of block_size rows. A block is dropped from a QoI's Sobol' analysis when any of its rows is failed or non-finite for that QoI. A Dice is NaN when the model and the reference masks are both empty (the necrotic Dice of the two-species solver whenever the session has no necrotic label), a log_vol_ratio when the reference is empty, msd / hd95 when either mask is empty, the mass-weighted field QoIs when the field's mass is at or below the mass floor.

thresholds.grid_rule: pairs with edema < core; the best pair maximises dice_core + dice_whole; the necrotic threshold is profiled on its own grid (the best value maximises dice_necrotic) and, in sampled mode, sampled independently of the core threshold

solver.densities: core: proliferative; whole: proliferative + necrotic; necrotic: necrotic

label_conventions.postop_core: in every later session the reference core is label 3 alone (since 2026-10-01): the two-compartment solver turns the cells killed by chemotherapy and radiotherapy necrotic, so after the resection only the enhancing tumour is comparable with a model's viable cells
label_conventions.preop_cavity: a pre-op segmentation with label 4 voxels is refused
label_conventions.postop_exclusion: label 4 voxels of the session's own segmentation, after the cavity correction, are removed from the model and the reference masks
label_conventions.cavity_correction: in a later session, label 1 voxels that any earlier later session of the design labelled 4 count as 4 (the union of the earlier sessions' label 4; the pre-op segmentation contributes none); the files on disk are unchanged
label_conventions.preop_core: the pre-op reference core is label 3 alone as well: the proliferative density is compared with the enhancing tumour in every session and the necrotic density with label 1
label_conventions.necrotic_reference: label 1 after the cavity correction, the session's excluded cavity removed; a session without a necrotic label has an undefined (NaN) necrotic Dice
label_conventions.densities: core: proliferative; whole: proliferative + necrotic; necrotic: necrotic
